item.title: what i learned about the knowledge graph
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on the knowledge graph, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

The knowledge graph shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: the case for the knowledge graph
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to the knowledge graph, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

The knowledge graph shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
